record.title: Pin supported action runtimes for typed workspace CI
record.intent: Remove the observed deprecated action runtime dependency while retaining the existing Python and uv toolchain.
requirements: Preserve the deprecation annotations and inspect official release revisions and action metadata for all three setup actions.
Pin exact supported Node 24 action commits; retain Python versions, uv version, read-only repository permissions, job timeout and both quality gates.
Inspect changed defaults and preserve intended cache pruning explicitly; record upstream release provenance and remaining hosted-runner image drift.
Push the workflow and require successful quality and installed-distribution gates on Linux and macOS without the previous Node 20 runtime annotations.
acceptance: The complete typed workspace CI passes using explicitly supported action runtimes.
